This is a senior backend engineering role at Airbnb focused on identity, authorization, and privacy systems underpinning their global lodging platform. The work centers on designing backend services and APIs that enforce identity and privacy rules across product surfaces, along with large-scale migrations away from legacy identity patterns and the tooling to run those migrations safely. The core stack is Java and Kotlin in a microservices environment with RPC frameworks, service IDLs, and dependency injection.
